note: This manifest is a concise, developer-focused map of the repository. It highlights structure, key files, relationships and where runtime/build artifacts live. If you want a file-for-file dump (all 3928 paths), I can produce that as a separate large JSON file on request.

top_level_overview.app/: Next.js app directory with route-based pages, API routes, layout and admin area. Primary source for site pages and server components.
top_level_overview.components/: React UI components, layout pieces (header, footer), and small reusable UI building blocks.
top_level_overview.lib/: Server and client helper modules: supabase clients, utilities for booking, seat-map, email helpers and shared types.
top_level_overview.scripts/: SQL migrations and helper scripts for DB setup, seeds and fixes. Important files: 001-create-tables.sql, 002-rls-policies.sql, 003-seed-data.sql, 004-fix-rls-and-admin.sql (and many others).
top_level_overview.public/: Static assets used by the site (images, icons, fallbacks).
top_level_overview.dist/.next/: Build output (Next/.next). Large; can be ignored for source analysis.
top_level_overview.package.json: Project dependencies and npm scripts. Use to install and run dev/build commands.
top_level_overview.sql-and-db-files: Top-level SQL and helper scripts for database maintenance and fixes (e.g., fix-user-columns.sql, update-venue-seatmap.sql, step0-rollback.sql, etc.).

app_pages_summary.purpose: Contains the app routes (Next.js App Router). Many server components and some client components. Pages drive navigation and import components and lib helpers.

notable_pages.role: Home page. Imports Header/Footer, fetches ensembles and shows from Supabase, renders hero, featured ensembles, upcoming shows and CTAs. (We read this file earlier.)
Shows listing page (forestillinger). Lists available shows and links to /bestill/[showId].
Ensemble detail page. Shows ensemble info and links to booking flows (/ensemble/[slug]/bestill and /bestill/[showId]).
Booking flow for ensemble enrollments. Uses programmatic navigation (router.push) to redirect to login or confirmation pages.
notable_pages.notes: Per code search, it pushes to `/logg-inn?redirect=...` when unauthenticated and to `/ensemble/${slug}/bekreftelse?reference=...` on success.

notable_pages.role: Course booking flow mirroring ensemble booking. Route pushes indicate redirect to login when needed and to /kurs/[slug]/bekreftelse on success.
Ticket purchase page for shows. Links to kasse and billetter after purchase.
Checkout page (kasse) and its nested `billett` route.
Booking confirmation page — shows booking details.
Playback / redirect page for recorded performances. Can redirect to external video endpoints.
Login page; various flows redirect to dashboard or earlier redirect query param. Header uses link to this page.
Registration page; may redirect to dashboard on success.
User profile pages; linked from dashboard and account menus.
User dashboard pages (dashboard, innstillinger, foresporsel, pamelding-tillatelser, etc.). Links to admin if user is admin.
Personal area; also has older/legacy pages under `min-side`.

Admin area with many subsections: ensembler, forestillinger, venues, kurs, rabatter, brukere, scan, statistics, bestillinger, innstillinger, legal pages. Admin routes call server-side helpers and admin APIs.

api_routes_summary.purpose: Server API endpoints used by frontend and admin UI. Many routes under `app/api/*` for seats, bookings, payments, enrollments and admin utilities.
examples: /app/api/seats/reserve/route.ts — seat reservation logic (critical for booking flow)
/app/api/video/stream/route.ts — stream or video-related endpoints used by playback pages
/app/api/admin/* — admin-only endpoints (verify-ticket, check-in, setup-db, stats, etc.)

components_and_layouts.components/: UI components and small presentational items. Header and Footer live in `components/layout/` and are used across pages.
components_and_layouts.components/layout/header.tsx: Client component used by `app/layout.tsx` — contains main nav, search form, user dropdown and mobile menu. Interacts with supabase browser client for auth state.
components_and_layouts.components/layout/footer.tsx: Site footer used at the bottom of pages.

lib_and_utils.lib/supabase/: Supabase helper clients — `client.ts` for browser, `server.ts` for server-side. Middleware helpers for auth and server data fetching.
lib_and_utils.lib/email/: Helpers for sending emails: ticket emails, enrollment emails, admin notifications. Used after purchases/enrollments.
lib_and_utils.lib/utils/: Booking helpers, seat generation and seat map utilities. Used by both UI and server code.
lib_and_utils.lib/seat-map-types.ts: Types used across seat-map and booking systems.

sql_and_migrations.scripts/: Contains SQL migration and RLS policy files (001-create-tables.sql, 002-rls-policies.sql, 003-seed-data.sql, and many more). These define DB schema and are the single source for DB setup.
sql_and_migrations.top_level_sql: There are also top-level SQL fixes like `fix-user-columns.sql`, `fix-user-signup-trigger.sql`, and `update-venue-seatmap.sql`.
sql_and_migrations.note: Per project instructions, when editing SQL work in the `scripts/000-complete-setup.sql` (or 000 file).

dev_and_build.package_manager: pnpm or npm (repo contains pnpm-lock.yaml and package.json)
dev_and_build.dev_server: next dev / next build outputs appear under `dist/.next/` — these are build artifacts and not source.

static_and_public.public/: Static files (images, svgs). Used by pages and components.
static_and_public.styles/: Global styles and Tailwind config files (tailwind.config.mjs, globals.css in app/).

observations_about_interconnectedness.auth: Auth flows use Supabase — header calls browser client, server pages use server client (lib/supabase/server.ts). Login and register pages redirect back to intended pages via query redirect parameters.
observations_about_interconnectedness.booking_flow: Booking goes: ensemble/kurs/forestillinger -> bestill -> kasse -> bekreftelse -> billetter. API endpoints under app/api/* coordinate seat reservation, purchase creation and emails.
observations_about_interconnectedness.admin: Admin routes reuse many lib helpers (email, supabase) and have dedicated API endpoints under app/api/admin/*. Admin UI links to admin API endpoints for management tasks and analytics.
observations_about_interconnectedness.seat-map: Seat generation and seat-map types/utilities live under lib/ and are used both client-side (seat selection UI) and server-side (seat reservation endpoints).
